description:
Drive operations available via the c64_drive tool.

Operations:
- reset: Issue an IEC reset for the selected drive slot. Required inputs: drive.
- power_on: Power on a specific Ultimate drive slot. Required inputs: drive.
- power_off: Power off a specific Ultimate drive slot. Required inputs: drive.
- load_rom: Temporarily load a custom ROM into an Ultimate drive slot. Required inputs: drive, path.
- set_mode: Set the emulation mode for a drive slot (1541/1571/1581). Required inputs: drive, mode.
